items.title: AI Agent Evaluation
items.summary: AI Agent evaluation focuses on continuous feedback loops: defining task-level metrics, measuring tool-call accuracy, tracking cost/latency, and iterating through eval harnesses. Good agents are evaluated on reliability and decision quality, not just final output.

items.title: Pet Longevity Research - AIM Protein
items.summary: A Tokyo university team developed a cat-specific AIM protein injection that may extend average cat lifespan from 15 to 30 years, targeting a 2027 market launch. The mechanism centers on AIM protein's role in immune regulation and organ protection.

items.title: Modern Deployment Workflow
items.summary: Vercel supports Git-integrated automatic deployments with preview environments separated from production. Environment variables and framework presets simplify the release pipeline for frontend teams.

items.title: Content Quality Signals in Social Platforms
items.summary: High-virality social content often combines personal storytelling with visual consistency and hashtag strategy. Understanding audience sentiment from comment engagement helps refine content direction.

items.title: Digital Asset Security Risks
items.summary: Online account security extends beyond passwords: insider threats, dormant-account hijacking, and recovery-process gaps can expose user assets. Strong audit trails and anomaly detection are critical for trust.
